Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 18

“Drupada, the sons of Draupadi, and the mighty-armed son of Subhadra all blew their conches, each one separately, O ruler of the earth.”

The list of conches closes — Sanjaya narrates all this to the blind king Dhritarashtra, a reminder throughout Chapter 1 that this whole scene is being relayed secondhand to a father anxious about his sons' fate.
